thermonuclear.deepReview: CHANGES at 4105bd13: one Medium, two roles recovering a regular file at the cache path concurrently.
thermonuclear.adjudication: Declined as not a defect. A regular file at $XDG_CACHE_HOME/legion-claude-code is something nothing in Legion creates: this block is the path's only writer (grep: plugins.go:384 alone), and it always runs mkdir -p before flock, so flock never meets a missing path and never creates a file. The pair's trigger needs that unreachable file and two roles racing on it. Even then it fails closed (one launch failure, after which the directory exists and the retry succeeds) and hides no error. The recovery branch is defensive code for a state the code cannot reach.
